\n\n

⇒ (a + b)/b = (c + d)/d

\n\n

\n\n

इसलिए, b : d = a + b : c + d

\n\n

पुनः,

\n\n

a ∶ b = c ∶ d

\n\n

⇒ a/b = c/d

\n\n

⇒ a/c = b/d

\n\n

इसलिए, a : c = b : d = a + b : c + d

\n\n

∴ अभीष्ट उत्तर a + b : c + d है।

x4 + x2 + 25

Total Area of Circle = Area of Sector × (360° / θ)

\n

πr2 = 66 × (360 / 60) = 66 × 6 = 396 cm2

\n

r2 = 396 ÷ (22/7) = 396 × (7 / 22) = 18 × 7 = 126

\n

r = √126 = √(9 × 14) = 3√14 cm

\n

∴ The correct option is D.

\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

Area of sector = 66 cm2

\n

Angle of sector (θ) = 60°

\n

Value of π ≈ 22/7

\n

Formula Used:

\n

Area of sector = (θ / 360°) × πr2

\n\n

Calculations:

\n

⇒ 66 = (60 / 360) × (22 / 7) × r2

\n

⇒ 66 = (1 / 6) × (22 / 7) × r2

\n

⇒ 66 = (22 / 42) × r2

\n

⇒ r2 = (66 × 42) / 22

\n

⇒ r2 = 3 × 42

\n

⇒ r2 = 126

\n

⇒ r = √126

\n

⇒ r = √(9 × 14)

\n

⇒ r = 3√14 cm

\n

∴ The correct option is D.

\n

Additional Information

\n

Length of Arc

\n

The length of the arc of a sector is given by l = (θ / 360°) × 2πr.

\n

Perimeter of a Sector

\n

The perimeter includes the arc length plus two radii: P = l + 2r = [(θ / 360°) × 2πr] + 2r.

\n

Area of Circle

\n

The total area of a circle with radius r is A = πr2.

\n

Area in terms of Arc Length

\n

If the arc length l is known, the area of the sector can be calculated as A = (1/2) × l × r. शॉर्टकट ट्रिक\n

\n\n

ఉపయోగించిన కాన్సెప్ట్:

\n\n

సెక్టార్ యొక్క వైశాల్యం  = πr2 × θ/360°

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

\\(\\rm\\frac{60^o}{360^o} × π r^2\\) = 66

\n\n

⇒ πr2 = 66 × 6

\n\n

⇒ 22/7 × r2 = 6 × 11 × 6

\n\n

⇒ r2 = 126

\n\n

⇒ r = 3\\(\\sqrt14\\) సెం.మీ

\n\n

కాబట్టి, వ్యాసార్థం = 3\\(\\sqrt14\\) సెం.మీ

\n\n

∴ వృత్తం యొక్క వ్యాసార్థం 3\\(\\sqrt14\\) సెం.మీ.

\n\n

ਇੱਕ ਚੱਕਰ ਦੇ ਸੈਕਟਰ ਦਾ ਖੇਤਰਫਲ 66 cm2 ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਸੈਕਟਰ ਦਾ ਕੋਣ 60° ਹੈ

\n\n

ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸੰਕਲਪ:

\n\n

ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ:

\n\n

ਇੱਕ ਚੱਕਰ ਦੇ ਸੈਕਟਰ ਦਾ ਖੇਤਰਫਲ 66 cm2 ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਸੈਕਟਰ ਦਾ ਕੋਣ 60° ਹੈ

\n\n

ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸੰਕਲਪ:

\n\n

ਇੱਕ ਸੈਕਟਰ ਦਾ ਖੇਤਰਫਲ = πr2 x θ/360°

\n\n

θ = ਸੈਕਟਰ ਦਾ ਕੋਣ

\n\n

r = ਅਰਧ ਵਿਆਸ

\n\n

ਗਣਨਾ:

\n\n

ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ਨ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ,

\n\n

\\(\\rm\\frac{60^o}{360^o} × π r^2\\) = 66

\n\n

⇒ πr2 = 66 x 6

\n\n

⇒ 22/7 x r2 = 6 x 11 x 6

\n\n

⇒ r2 = 126

\n\n

⇒ r = 3\\(\\sqrt14\\) cm

\n\n

ਇਸ ਲਈ, ਅਰਧ ਵਿਆਸ = 3\\(\\sqrt14\\) cm

\n\n

∴ ਚੱਕਰ ਦਾ ਅਰਧ ਵਿਆਸ 3\\(\\sqrt14\\) cm ਹੈ।

\n", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Number System"], "concept": "Number System", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "63a5d37a4b25d6f28c2cadf2", "qs_no": 23, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "If (cos q + sin q) = 31/25, then what will be the value of cos2 q?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "522/625"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "512/625"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "513/625"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "576/625"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "यदि (cos q + sin q) = 31/25 है, तो cos2 q का मान क्या होगा?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "522/625"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "512/625"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "513/625"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "576/625"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Given: 

\n\n

(cos q + sin q) = 31/25

\n\n

Concept used:

\n\n

Sin2θ + Cos2θ = 1

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

(cos q + sin q) = 31/25      -----(i)

\n\n

⇒ (cos q + sin q)2 = (31/25)2

\n\n

⇒ cos2 q + sin2 q + 2cosqsinq = 961/625

\n\n

⇒ 1 + 2cosqsinq = 961/625

\n\n

⇒ 2cosqsinq = 961/625 - 1

\n\n

⇒ 2cosqsinq = 336/625

\n\n

Now,

\n\n

(cos q - sin q)2 = cos2 q + sin2 q - 2cosqsinq

\n\n

⇒ (cos q - sin q)2 = 1 - 336/625

\n\n

⇒ (cos q - sin q)2 = 289/625

\n\n

⇒ (cos q - sin q) = 17/25      ----(ii)

\n\n

From eq (i) and eq (ii) we get,

\n\n

2cos q = 48/25

\n\n

⇒ cos q = 24/25

\n\n

So, cos2 q = (24/25)2

\n\n

⇒ 576/625

\n\n

∴ The required answer is 576/625.

\n\n

Shortcut Trick

\n\n

Concept Used:

\n\n

Sinθ = Opposite/ Hypotenuse(O/H)

\n\n

Cosθ = Adjacent/ Hypotenuse(A/H)

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

According to the question, 

\n\n

⇒ cos q + sin q = 31/25

\n\n

⇒ A/H + O/H = 31/25

\n\n

⇒ (A + O)/H = 31/25

\n\n

So we get, H as 25 and (A + O) = 31

\n\n

Now we know a triplet as 7, 24, and 25

\n\n

This satisfies the given condition,

\n\n

Using the values, we get,  

\n\n

Cos q = A/H = 24/25

\n\n

So, cos2 q = (24/25)2

\n\n

⇒ 576/625

\n\n

∴ The required answer is 576/625.

Shortcut Trick\n

By using the Alligation method, we can directly find the ratio of boys to girls.

\n

Ratio of Boys to Girls = (Girls Average − Overall Average) : (Overall Average − Boys Average)

\n

Ratio = (65 − 62) : (62 − 60) = 3 : 2

\n

Total parts = 3 + 2 = 5 parts = 60 students ⇒ 1 part = 12 students.

\n

Number of boys = 3 parts = 3 × 12 = 36.

\n

∴ The correct answer is 36.

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

Total number of students in the class = 60

\n

Overall average marks of the class = 62

\n

Average marks of boys = 60

\n

Average marks of girls = 65

\n

Formula Used:

\n

Total marks = Average marks × Number of students

\n\n\n\n

Calculations:

\n

Let the number of boys be B and the number of girls be G.

\n

⇒ B + G = 60

\n

⇒ G = 60 − B

\n

Total marks of all students = Total marks of boys + Total marks of girls

\n

⇒ 62 × 60 = (60 × B) + (65 × G)

\n

⇒ 3720 = 60B + 65(60 − B)

\n

⇒ 3720 = 60B + 3900 − 65B

\n

⇒ 65B − 60B = 3900 − 3720

\n

⇒ 5B = 180

\n

⇒ B = 180 ÷ 5 = 36

\n

∴ The correct answer is 36.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n

Alligation Rule

\n

Alligation is a quick technique to find the ratio in which two components are mixed. The ratio is determined by taking the cross-difference of individual averages from the overall mixture's average.

\n

Weighted Average Formula

\n

When two groups of sizes n1 and n2 have averages A1 and A2 respectively, the combined average is given by: A = (n1A1 + n2A2) ÷ (n1 + n2).

\n

Net Deviation Method

\n

In any valid dataset, the total sum of deviations of all group items from their true combined average must equal zero. This property allows solving without multiplying large values.

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

\n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "wholly"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "hardly"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "slowly"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "heavily"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

The correct answer is: heavily

\n\n

Key Points

\n\n
    \n\t
  • Collocation is the combination of words formed when two or more words are often used together in a way that sounds correct.
    • \n\t
  • Let us look at the meaning of the given words.\n\t
      \n\t\t
    • Wholly: Entirely; fully. (पूर्णत)
      • \n\t\t
    • Hardly: In a severe or harsh manner. (कठिनाई से)
      • \n\t\t
    • Slowly: At a slow speed; not quickly. (धीरे से)
      • \n\t\t
    • Heavily: To a great degree; in large amounts. (भारी)
      • \n\t
    \n\t
    • \n\t
  • "Heavily fined" means charging someone an amount of money as a punishment for not obeying a rule or law.
    • \n\t
  • So, as per the meaning of the given words "Heavily" should be used here.
    • \n\t
  • The implied meaning of the sentence is: Drivers who violate this rule face hefty fines.
    • \n\t
  • Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.
    \n\t 
    • \n
\n\n

Complete sentence: Motorists committing this infraction are heavily fined.

    ", "hn": "", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Grammar"], "concept": "Grammar", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "63a5e331b8a70a58024ad2d5", "qs_no": 6, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "

    Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

    \n\n

    Latika said to him, "I got a hefty discount on this television."

    \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Latika told him that she has got a hefty discount on that television."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Latika told him that she is getting a hefty discount on that television."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Latika told him that she had got a hefty discount on that television."}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Latika told him that she has got a hefty discount on this television."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    The correct answer is: Latika told him that she had got a hefty discount on that television.

    \n\n

    Key Points 

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • The given sentence is in direct speech and we need to convert it to indirect speech.
      • \n\t
    • When we change a direct speech to an indirect speech, we must follow these rules:\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • The reporting verb "said" changes to "told" in the indirect speech.
        • \n\t\t
      • The inverted commas ("...") are replaced with the conjunction 'that' to show the indirect speech part.
        • \n\t\t
      • The comma (,) is removed in the indirect speech.
        • \n\t\t
      • The first word of the indirect speech should be in capital letters.
        • \n\t\t
      • The pronoun "I" changes with respect to the reporter i.e. "she" and the auxiliary verb changes as per the tense.\n\t\t
          \n\t\t\t
        • The tense of the given direct speech is simple past tense which will be changed into past perfect tense.
          • \n\t\t\t
        • Direct: “I did the work”, he said.
          • \n\t\t\t
        • Indirect: He said that he had done the work.
          • \n\t\t
        \n\t\t
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • Thus, option 3 is the correct answer.
      \n\t 
      • \n
    \n\n

    Hence, indirect speech is - Latika told him that she had got a hefty discount on that television.

      • \n\t

    Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

    Last before year, Shirley got very good grades.

    \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "The last year before"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Before last year"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "The year before last year"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Before year last"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    The correct answer is: The year before last year.

    \n\n

    Key Points

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • The most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence is: The year before last year
      • \n\t
    • In this case, the phrase "the year before last year" is the most suitable choice because it accurately conveys the meaning that Shirley achieved good grades in the year prior to the year immediately preceding the current one.
      • \n\t
    • The rule that applies here is the use of ordinal numbers and the phrase "before last." In English, when referring to a year that is two years prior to the current one, it is common to use the phrase "the year before last year." This structure provides clarity and avoids ambiguity in the chronological sequence of events.
